en.headline: Dairy Queen to open four Hong Kong stores from November
en.dek: The American ice-cream chain plans a Causeway Bay flagship at One Causeway Bay, followed by outlets in Kwun Tong, the New Territories and outlying islands, marking its return after a brief 1979 presence.
body: American ice-cream chain Dairy Queen will open four stores in Hong Kong in the fourth quarter of 2026, the company said, beginning with a flagship at One Causeway Bay in November.

A second outlet is already under hoarding at The Angle shopping centre in Kwun Tong. The remaining two stores will be located in the New Territories and on an outlying island, giving the brand coverage across Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, the New Territories and the islands before the end of the year.

The chain last operated briefly in Causeway Bay in 1979. The new Hong Kong concept will feature five product lines including milkshakes, parfaits and ice-cream cakes, alongside the signature Blizzard soft-serve. The company has previously indicated longer-term plans for a larger network in the city.
Opening dates for the individual stores after the Causeway Bay launch have not yet been specified.

zh.headline: Dairy Queen 11月起連開四店重返香港
zh.dek: 美國雪糕品牌首店落戶銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay，觀塘The Angle亦已圍板，另兩店將覆蓋新界及離島，相隔近半世紀後再臨。
body: 美國雪糕品牌Dairy Queen宣布將於2026年第四季在香港開設四間分店，首店定於11月在銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay開業。
觀塘The Angle商場分店已開始圍板工程。其餘兩間將分別設於新界及離島，令品牌在年底前覆蓋港島、九龍、新界及離島。
品牌上一次於1979年在銅鑼灣短暫開業。今次香港店將提供五條產品線，包括奶昔、芭菲及雪糕蛋糕，以及招牌Blizzard軟雪糕。公司早前亦透露有意在港建立更大規模網絡。
除銅鑼灣首店外，其餘分店的確實開業日期尚未公布。
